title: DSA Roadmap - Easy to Medium to Hard
description: Web-app ready DSA problem dataset extracted from the provided PDF. Part A contains the 502 DSA Master Sheet problems and Part B contains the 216 LearnYard problems.

source_notes.part_a_difficulty_rule: 1-2 stars = Easy, 3 stars = Medium, 4-5 stars = Hard
source_notes.links_note: URLs are taken from the clickable links embedded in the PDF. GFG links are the PDF's Google 'I'm Feeling Lucky' redirects when present.
